name: ZCH_CLNS_CP_RESULTS
description: The table contain the response for daas WS for call to verify phone and email.

columns.name: DATA_MGMT_BATCH_ID
columns.description: The DATA_MGMT_BATCH_ID of parent validation batch.

columns.name: VERIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which phone or email verification was done.

columns.name: CLNS_CP_RESULT_ID
columns.description: The primary key for verification results for email and phone for the entity

columns.name: PARENT_RECORD_ID
columns.description: The  primary key for verification results for verification results phone and email for entity

columns.name: OBJ_NAME
columns.description: The type of the object that needs to be verified. Email, phone or Location

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier assigned for clustering records for parallel processing

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: The contact point id selected for phone or email verification

columns.name: ORIG_ATTR_VALUE
columns.description: The original value for phone or email selected for  verification.

columns.name: VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.description: The verification status returned by DAAS in response

columns.name: ORIG_VERIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: The original verification date for  contact point

columns.name: ORIG_VERIFICATION_STATUS
columns.description: The original verification status for contact point

columns.name: USAGE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The record level status code to indicate the  update status to TCA

columns.name: ORIG_VERSION
columns.description: This is original version for contact point stored in OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER in HZ_CONTACT_POINT

columns.name: VERIFICATION_DETAILS
columns.description: The detailed status for verification call to DAAS.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
